title: Crestline Fleet Account Tenure Credit on Brake Corrections
content:
A long-standing Crestline Fleet Account has a tenure credit added to the pricing correction on a brake invoice posted with no fleet discount.

| Account approved | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 60 or more whole months before today | 15.00 |
| 36 to 59 whole months before today | 7.50 |
| more recently (fewer than 36 whole months) | nothing |

Tenure is read from the approval date on the fleet account and counted in whole months up to today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Whole months since approval | Tenure credit |
|---|---|
| 35 | none |
| 36 | 7.50 |
| 59 | 7.50 |
| 60 | 15.00 |

## Where the amount sits

Because a fleet invoice posted without the program discount is Crestline's billing error, make-good amounts are added to the pricing correction on a brake invoice that an account invoiced without sales tax received with no fleet discount at all. The correction starts from the restored discount (the fleet discount the brake jobs should have carried less the discount the invoice already carried). The limit of the invoice amount less the credit memos and early-pay discounts already on the invoice is applied last, after every make-good amount, and prevails over every other part of the correction rule, so a correction can fall below the restored discount only when that limit is lower; the correction is rounded half up to the cent once, after the limit.
